shared_elements: single large upright anthropomorphic figure filling the field
incised linear detailing on the body/garment
elaborated headgear/hair mass above the head
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a single upright humanoid figure with incised body decoration including a roundel/disc and a prominent mass of headgear or hair, but these are generic anthropomorphic conventions rather than a shared specific scheme. A shows a bearded, winged figure in strict profile striding with one hand raised and an object carried in the other, rendered with dense naturalistic detail of muscles, feathers and fringed garment; B is a frontal, blocky, radically schematic figure with only a few abstract incised emblems and no wings, held attributes or profile action.
